rules.statement: Documents D3, D4, and D7 do not constitute a valid agreement in writing under section 21(4) of the Ordinance of Frauds and Perjuries No. 7 of 1840.
rules.supporting_quote: "Can it be suggested that in the construction of the sub-section, the English decisions on section 17 can be applied in the absence of the words 'some note or memorandum' and where the section requires that the contract or agreement itself should be in writing, if it is to be of any force or avail in law?"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 21(4) of the Ordinance of Frauds and Perjuries No. 7 of 1840
